title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro de Dados Sênior em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a Volpi  Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente! O desafio  Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer  para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base. Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio. Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos. O que você vai fazer:  Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse  na AWS; Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming); Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ; Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio; Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia); Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3); Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados; Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.  O que esperamos de você:  Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev); Domínio de Python e SQL  para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção; Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM; Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ; Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis; Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia; Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero; Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end; Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis; Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.  Será considerado um diferencial:  Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse; Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares); Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros; Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.  Benefícios que oferecemos:  Modelo remoto prioritário Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes) R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação 30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano Day off no aniversário TotalPass (incluindo TotalMind) Acesso ao Wework Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide)
description:

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance  At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether  Tether Finance:  Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power:  Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data:  Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us?  Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future?  About the job  As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes: New Products and Features  - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry. Performance  - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Security  - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.  Responsibilities  Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including: New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies. Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools. Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.  Requirements  With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend. Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture. Comfortable with high-availability concepts. Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+. Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these. Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools. Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs. Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life. Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.  Important information for candidates  Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels.  We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:  Verify the recruiter’s identity.  All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods.  We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses.  All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details.  If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.  When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade):  Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes. Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas:  Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados. Infraestrutura Cloud:  Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS  ou Azure  e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock  ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven. AI Guardrails:  Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos. Avaliação Sistemática:  Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção. Eficiência de Custos:  Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.  O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:  Linguagens:  Domínio avançado de Python  e Java  para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA. DevOps/MLOps:  Experiência com Docker , Containerization  e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem. Educação:  Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.  VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:  Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) . Forecast: Apoiar na organização e acompanhamento do pipeline comercial Inteligência Competitiva: \"Realizar benchmarking constante de soluções HXM no mercado, identificando diferenciais competitivos e gaps no nosso portfólio para municiar a coordenação com argumentos de defesa de valor e combate à concorrência.\" Governança: Acompanhar e apoiar a Coordenação nos rituais de governança com as unidades de negócio (DRGs/Franquias), garantindo que as políticas de precificação e as regras de engajamento comercial sejam cumpridas de forma padronizada, reduzindo a necessidade de intervenção direta da coordenação em temas recorrentes  Gestão Estratégica da Base (Foco em CS e Expansão): Analisar a taxa de ocupação e o comportamento de uso das soluções, apoiando no desenho planos de ação para Cross-sell e Up-sell em contas estratégicas. Propor melhorias nos fluxos operacionais (propostas, contratação e faturamento) para reduzir o atrito e acelerar o time-to-revenue.  Articulação e Influência (Postura de Liderança): Atuar como ponto focal técnico de produtos de RH perante o time comercial e áreas transversais (CS, Finanças, Produto). Posicionar-se em fóruns de decisão, defendendo diretrizes comerciais e garantindo o alinhamento das unidades com a estratégia de expansão da companhia.  Capacitação do time de AR Disseminar boas práticas e conteúdos técnicos de forma propositiva, elevando o nível de maturidade comercial da rede.  O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:  Capacidade Analítica: Conforto em trabalhar com dados para defender pontos de vista. Resiliência e Firmeza: Habilidade para dizer \"não\" a pedidos comerciais que fogem da regra, embasando a decisão com lógica técnica. Domínio de HR Tech: Entender as dores de um RH (Recrutamento, Treinamento, Payroll, etc.) para falar a língua do cliente e do time comercial. Produtividade: Boa organização e capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas Comunicação: Comunicação clara e facilidade de interação com diferentes áreas Experiência com análise de dados e acompanhamento de dashboards comerciais Vivência com fluxos de aprovação e processos de governança comercial Noções de pricing (formação de preço, descontos, margem) Experiência em operações comerciais estruturadas (Sales Ops / RevOps) Perfil com viés de Customer Success, com boa gestão de interações e stakeholders  INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS  Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média. A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados. E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente. Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma. Dito isso, oferecemos: ● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador; ● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais; ● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores; ● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria... ● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito; ● Plano de saúde e odontológico; ● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação; ● Vale transporte; ● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida; ● Espaço de lactário; ● Bicicletário; ● Vestiário; ● Seguro de vida; ● Auxílio creche; ● Previdência privada; ● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar; ● Gympass. Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc. #Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

Quality, Performance & SEO  Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship. Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server-side events where needed). Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.  Collaboration  Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds. Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation. Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.  Required Skills  Technical  3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization). Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content). Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus). Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself. Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions. Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.  Modern Web Skills  Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies). Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling). Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation). Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).  Bonus Experience  (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience. Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs). Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends. Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows. E-commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify). Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.  Soft Skills  Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks. Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code. Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon. Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team. Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.  What Success Looks Like  In the first 60–90 days, you will: Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end. Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves). Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern. Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior Writer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior Writer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Writer (Roteirista)  Location:  Remote Position Type:  Contract Company:  Pocket FM About Us  At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series. Role Overview  As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective. Key Responsibilities  1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy  Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization. Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy. Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks. Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.  2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight  Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers. Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth. Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation. Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.  3. Team Management & Leadership  Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows. Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team. Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team. Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.  4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization  Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion. Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements. Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback. Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.  5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control  Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output. Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content. Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.  6. User-Centric Content Improvement  Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches. Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges. Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.  7. Stakeholder Collaboration  Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets. Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans. Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.  8. Promotion & Growth Strategy  Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows. Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.  Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field. Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms. Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams. Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies. Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions. Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.  Key Traits for Success  Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Machine Learning Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer  who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations  behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion  within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us. What you’ll do  Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models  for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling  to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions  that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences  within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.  What we’re looking for  We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you. You’ll be successful  in this role if you have : Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms  (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Required Qualifications  Proven Leadership:  Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment. Language:  Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.  Nice to Have Skills  Go (Golang) Experience:  Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components. Cloud Infrastructure:  Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms. Domain Knowledge:  Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems. Big Tech Experience:  Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Empresa está contratando LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)  to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors. Key Responsibilities:  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties  Market & Network Development  Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred  Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

Key Projects:  Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services. Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores. Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.  Qualifications: What you bring to the team  You have:  5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development. Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js. Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis. Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services. Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps). You might also have:  Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience. AWS Certifications. Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus). Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation. Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture. description:

Atuamos como um hub de produtos financeiros escaláveis, geradores de valor e focados em transformar a experiência de quem utiliza serviços essenciais. Estamos em constante evolução e buscamos pessoas que queiram construir o futuro com a gente, com inovação, tecnologia, impacto real e foco no cliente. Responsabilidades e atribuições:   Ser o owner técnico de um domínio ou subsistema, garantindo evolução segura e saudável ao longo do tempo. Garantir que o domínio opere com SLOs acordados (latência/erros/disponibilidade) e trabalhar ativamente para melhorar a confiabilidade. Liderar planejamento técnico e execução do domínio: decomposição, dependências, riscos, execução e validação. Elevar consistentemente o nível técnico do time: boas práticas, revisão forte, referências, documentação e padrões. Ser referência técnica interna: apoiar decisões complexas, destravar discussões e reduzir retrabalho. Liderar resposta a incidentes do seu domínio: mitigação, RCA rigoroso e ações preventivas estruturais.  Requisitos e qualificações:   TypeScript + Node.js (async/await, promises, error handling; event loop, streams e concorrência). Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com OpenAPI (contratos, validação e status codes). SQL (Postgres): consultas, migrations, otimização de queries e índices. Git e fluxo de PRs (commits pequenos, rebase e resolução simples de conflitos). Testes automatizados (unitários, integração e contrato) com Jest. CI/CD e deploy: pipeline (lint/test/build/deploy), smoke tests, variáveis e logs. Observabilidade: logs estruturados, métricas básicas e tracing superficial. Mensageria e resiliência (BullMQ/RabbitMQ): retry, DLQ, idempotência e ordering quando necessário. Performance e escalabilidade: profiling, gargalos comuns e trade-offs. System design básico aplicado: rate limit, circuit breaker, bulkhead e degradação graciosa. Concorrência e integridade: locks e consistência (otimista/pessimista). Noções de NoSQL e cache (TTL e riscos de inconsistência). Gestão de incidentes: mitigação, RCA/post-mortem e ações preventivas. Compartilhar feedback do mercado brasileiro sobre tendências de demanda, preços, concorrentes, hábitos de compra e oportunidades de canais.  4) Qualificações Mais de 2 anos de experiência em eletrodomésticos comerciais, equipamentos para hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, refrigeração, lavanderia comercial, cozinhas industriais, HVAC, ventilação ou vendas B2B de equipamentos. Experiência com hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, empresas de facilities ou distribuidores de equipamentos será considerada um diferencial. Recursos existentes de clientes ou canais no Brasil serão uma forte vantagem. Inglês profissional para comunicação de negócios será considerado um diferencial. Português fluente é necessário para comunicação local no Brasil.  5) Modelo de Trabalho Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação em desenvolvimento de negócios. As principais áreas de atuação incluem: Desenvolvimento de clientes Acompanhamento de RFQs e cotações Comunicação sobre produtos e soluções Desenvolvimento de canais Feedback do mercado local Suporte ao avanço de projetos  Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall poderá oferecer oportunidades de cooperação regional de longo prazo, com base em recursos de clientes verificados, progresso dos projetos e contribuição comercial real. 6) Benefícios da Cooperação A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho e à contribuição comercial real, incluindo: Desenvolvimento de clientes Criação de oportunidades qualificadas Avanço de RFQs Desenvolvimento de canais Progresso de projetos Resultados de pedidos e negócios  Os termos detalhados de cooperação poderão ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com a experiência do candidato, recursos de clientes, capacidade regional e contribuição para projetos. 7) Como se Candidatar Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo para:  Assunto do e-mail: Representante Comercial – Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais – Brasil

description:

Proven hunter mindset  — track record of acquiring new enterprise / mid-market clients from zero and consistently exceeding revenue targets. Deep understanding of the cross-border e-commerce ecosystem  in Brazil and/or Mexico, including key sellers, marketplaces (Mercado Libre, Amazon, Shopee, Magalu, etc.), customs frameworks (e.g., Remessa Conforme  in Brazil, IMMEX / Section 321  dynamics in Mexico), and last-mile landscape. Strong existing network with cross-border sellers, freight forwarders, and last-mile partners  in your market. Commercial maturity — comfortable with pricing models, P&L conversations, and structured negotiation. Fluent in Portuguese (Brazil) or Spanish (Mexico) AND English . Mandarin is a strong plus. Self-starter, comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous, market-entry environment. Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent is a plus.

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)  Please upload your CV Resume in English.  Monthly salary:  $5,000 - $6,500  USD Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real. The role:  They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director. This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application. What you’ll do:  Take prototypes to production.  The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users. Own AI engineering decisions.  Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills. Build full-stack.  Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed. Harden and deploy.  CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe. Close the loop with stakeholders.  Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it. Manage and extend the verified query set.  Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy. Close the feedback loop.  User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use. Work with AI agents.  Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.  Tech you’ll work with:  Application layer:  TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI. AI / LLM integration:  Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol) Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products. Data layer:  Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0 You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics. Infrastructure:  Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.  What they’re looking for:  Must-haves  AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems. You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully. Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI. Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real. Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people. AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system. AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty. Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.  Nice-to-haves:  Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics Snowflake / SQL analytics experience Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX Azure cloud platform experience LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime  How our partner works:  Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team. Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership. Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers. Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase. Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.  Benefits:  A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays.  *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.
